question: How many signals, bacteria and replicates made up the feature matrix for pattern recognition?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE regexp_matches(lower(text), 'matrix|replicate|signal|pattern recognition|feature') ORDER BY page, id LIMIT 150
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE id IN ('p6.L25','p6.L26','p6.L27','p6.L28','p6.L29') OR (page=6 AND line_no BETWEEN 24 AND 30) ORDER BY id

SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(a.text,'\((\d+) signals',1) AS INT) * CAST(regexp_extract(a.text,'× (\d+)\s*$',1) AS INT) * CAST(regexp_extract(b.text,'×(\d+) replicates',1) AS INT) AS matrix_rows FROM lines a, lines b WHERE a.id='p6.L26' AND b.id='p6.L27'
